BEGIN TRANSACTION;
CREATE TABLE activity (
  seq      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  project  TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind     TEXT NOT NULL,
  detail   TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE agents (
  project    TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider   TEXT NOT NULL,
  first_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, agent_id)
);
INSERT INTO "agents" VALUES('<FIXTURE>/fixture-project','agent','agent',<EPOCH_MS>,<EPOCH_MS>);
CREATE TABLE deliveries (
  message_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project      TEXT NOT NULL,
  recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  read_at      INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (message_id, recipient_id)
);
CREATE TABLE delivery_claims (
  message_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project      TEXT NOT NULL,
  recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  claimed_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (message_id, recipient_id)
);
CREATE TABLE graph_attempts (
  project        TEXT NOT NULL,
  graph_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  node_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  attempt        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  restart        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  state          TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id         TEXT,
  run_dir        TEXT,
  input_attempts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  adapter        TEXT NOT NULL,
  model          TEXT NOT NULL,
  account        TEXT NOT NULL,
  holds_slot     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  kept           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  gate_procs     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  outcome        TEXT,
  updated_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, graph_id, node_id, revision, attempt, restart)
);
CREATE TABLE graph_revisions (
  project       TEXT NOT NULL,
  graph_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  document_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  plan_json     TEXT,
  spec_hash     TEXT,
  origin        TEXT,
  created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, graph_id, revision)
);
CREATE TABLE graph_worktree_reservations (
  realpath   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project    TEXT NOT NULL,
  graph_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  node_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  attempt    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  token      TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE graphs (
  project          TEXT NOT NULL,
  graph_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state            TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_pid        INTEGER,
  owner_started    TEXT,
  chair_identity   TEXT NOT NULL,
  cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, graph_id)
);
CREATE TABLE landing_leases (
  project TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  holder TEXT NOT NULL,
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expected_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pushing_until INTEGER,
  released_at INTEGER
);
CREATE TABLE messages (
  message_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project         TEXT NOT NULL,
  sender_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  body            TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'note',
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  reply_to        TEXT REFERENCES messages(message_id),
  task_id         TEXT,
  output_path     TEXT,
  created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE run_observations (
  project     TEXT NOT NULL,
  recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(project, recipient_id, run_id, task_id)
);
CREATE TABLE sessions (
  project             TEXT NOT NULL,
  name                TEXT NOT NULL,
  adapter             TEXT,
  provider_session_id TEXT,
  run_id              TEXT,
  task_id             TEXT,
  attempt             INTEGER,
  result_path         TEXT,
  turn_claim          TEXT NOT NULL,
  turn_kind           TEXT NOT NULL,
  turn_run_id         TEXT,
  turn_task_id        TEXT,
  turn_attempt        INTEGER,
  turn_status         TEXT,
  turn_pid            INTEGER,
  created_by          TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_by          TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at          INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at          INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, name)
);
CREATE TABLE task_dependencies (
  project    TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  depends_on TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, task_id, depends_on)
);
CREATE TABLE tasks (
  project    TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  objective  TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_id   TEXT,
  state      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, task_id)
);
CREATE TABLE team_members (
  project  TEXT NOT NULL,
  team_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, team_id, agent_id)
);
CREATE TABLE teams (
  project    TEXT NOT NULL,
  team_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project, team_id)
);
CREATE TABLE work_claims (
  generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  project TEXT NOT NULL,
  holder TEXT NOT NULL,
  issue TEXT,
  paths TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  released_at INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX messages_by_conversation
  ON messages(project, conversation_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX deliveries_unread
  ON deliveries(project, recipient_id, read_at);
CREATE INDEX delivery_claims_expiry
  ON delivery_claims(project, recipient_id, expires_at);
CREATE INDEX activity_by_project ON activity(project, seq);
CREATE INDEX work_claims_active ON work_claims(project, expires_at, released_at);
CREATE INDEX graph_attempts_by_pool ON graph_attempts(adapter, model, account, holds_slot);
DELETE FROM "sqlite_sequence";
COMMIT;
